findings.message: 19.P3.serve-activation requires triage/Author’s Driver and Effects to share checkout.journal, but triage_pass internally constructs Driver.from_config, which creates a separate Journal without a caller binding seam. Both chupa/triage.py and chupa/driver.py are unfenced. CHUPA_PLAN.md:2237 explicitly requires correcting the implementing seed’s fence before implementation and prohibits copying triage or replacing its writer through runtime monkeypatching.
findings.paved_road: Regenerate the implementing seed under 19.L with chupa/triage.py fenced for minimal shared-journal binding, including Context and caller closure; preserve public signatures, the registry fence floor, and unchanged preservation suites.
